item.title: Ask HN: Are there any production LLM pipeline setups to learn from?
item.summary: I believe vLLM has been the gold standard for inferencing but I'd like to learn how vLLM, langgraph, langfuse, other observability and business logic is meld into a single setup. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49273774 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
